meta.title: Mateusz Kabaja — Web Developer
meta.description: Portfolio of Mateusz Kabaja — web developer. Web projects, JavaScript, React, PHP, design and 3D.

about.intro: Hi, I'm Mateusz — a web developer who blends curiosity for code with a love of aesthetics and modern design.
about.p1: For over a year I've been growing as a front-end developer. Building websites gives me real satisfaction — especially when functionality and looks come together into something that truly works and looks great.
about.p2: I enjoy projects that let me learn and experiment — with animations, responsive layouts or application logic. What motivates me most is the moment an idea from my notebook comes alive in the browser.
about.p3: Beyond code I'm into graphic and 3D design — I often use Figma and Spline to give projects depth and character. I'm growing towards full-stack, combining React with a PHP backend.
about.availability1: I live in Poland (Wieliczka) and I'm open to remote collaboration with clients from all over the world — flexible about communication and where we work.
about.availability2: I'm looking for new challenges: both a permanent role in a team and projects for individual clients. If you have a project in mind, don't hesitate to reach out.
